title: Introduction To Pedology And Soil Classification
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are considered a special group of Inceptisols, presently classified under the Andept suborder (also known as Andosols)."
Soils derived from volcanic ash are considered a special group of Inceptisols, presently classified under the Andept suborder (also known as Andosols).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an intensive system of farming; as such the soil nutrients get depleted and exhausted at certain stages of the land use."
Crop rotation is an intensive system of farming; as such the soil nutrients get depleted and exhausted at certain stages of the land use.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used for a variety of purposes which interact and may compete with one another; therefore, it is desirable to plan and manage all uses in an integrated manner."
Land resources are used for a variety of purposes which interact and may compete with one another; therefore, it is desirable to plan and manage all uses in an integrated manner.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a challenge due to the complex nature of soil formation and the inherent capacity of the soil resource."
Appliction in the field is a challenge due to the complex nature of soil formation and the inherent capacity of the soil resource.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most prevalent element in the Earth's crust and in soils."
Oxygen is the most prevalent element in the Earth's crust and in soils.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an increasingly dominant factor in soil formation with increased time, mainly because of the effects of precipitation and temperature."
Climate is an increasingly dominant factor in soil formation with increased time, mainly because of the effects of precipitation and temperature.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the combination of rock, mineral fragments (pieces) made by weathering (wind, rain, sun, snow, etc.), and organic matter (living things), water, and air."
Soil is the combination of rock, mineral fragments (pieces) made by weathering (wind, rain, sun, snow, etc.), and organic matter (living things), water, and air.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used by farmers and ranchers to help determine whether a particular soil type is suited for crops or livestock and what type of management might be required."
The information is used by farmers and ranchers to help determine whether a particular soil type is suited for crops or livestock and what type of management might be required.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the rocks that have been broken down into smaller pieces."
The inorganic materials are the rocks that have been broken down into smaller pieces.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the breakdown and changes in rocks and sediments at or near the Earth's surface brought about by biological, chemical, and physical agents or combinations thereof."
Weathering refers to the breakdown and changes in rocks and sediments at or near the Earth's surface brought about by biological, chemical, and physical agents or combinations thereof.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a vertical cut, two dimensional, in the soil and bounds one side of a pedon."
A profile is a vertical cut, two dimensional, in the soil and bounds one side of a pedon.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called its topography (sometimes called relief)."
The earth's surface contour is called its topography (sometimes called relief).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the alteration of the rock into new minerals."
Chemical weathering is the alteration of the rock into new minerals.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are composed of sedimentary rock and cover the Sokoto plains, Chad Basin, Niger-Benue trough, western areas of Nigeria, south-eastern Nigeria and coastal margins and swamps."
The lowland areas are composed of sedimentary rock and cover the Sokoto plains, Chad Basin, Niger-Benue trough, western areas of Nigeria, south-eastern Nigeria and coastal margins and swamps.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a mixture of different things; rocks, minerals, and dead, decaying plants and animals."
Soils are a mixture of different things; rocks, minerals, and dead, decaying plants and animals.

major plateaux surfaces

Compositing
Compositing is a term used for the application of decomposed heaps of plant and animal remains to the soil.

Gypsum is used in the construction industry, to build buildings and houses. • Oxidation: this process occurs when oxygen combines with compound elements in rocks to form oxides.
______ is the relative relations of the components sand, silt and clay most often reported as percentages on a mass basis.

Soil texture is the relative relations of the components sand, silt and clay most often reported as percentages on a mass basis.
______ is the smallest three dimensional units, but not less than 1 meter square on top, that captures the lateral range of variability.
pedon
The pedon is the smallest three dimensional units, but not less than 1 meter square on top, that captures the lateral range of variability.
______ is a continuous assessment component of your course.
TMA
The TMA is a continuous assessment component of your course.
______ refers to the upper layer of soil, nearest the surface.
Horizon A
Horizon A refers to the upper layer of soil, nearest the surface.
______ is a dynamic subject, from the structure of the system itself, to the definitions of classes, and finally in the application in the field.
Soil classification
Soil classification is a dynamic subject, from the structure of the system itself, to the definitions of classes, and finally in the application in the field.
______ is the field observable attributes of the soil within the various soil horizons and the description of the kind and arrangement of the horizons.

Soil morphology is the field observable attributes of the soil within the various soil horizons and the description of the kind and arrangement of the horizons.
